flags.text: Unnecessary LLM format restrictions, mandatory repeated audits, per-example approvals and whole-corpus/benchmark certification gates are removed. Correct arithmetic, saved answers, actual audio, source accounting, secret handling and honest missing data remain specified. A useful local installation does not depend on completion of all corpus acquisition or benchmark collection. The full-source features and completeness reporting remain required.
flags.disposition: Explicit negation/removal of the matched prerequisite; no surviving mandatory human/approval/wire gate in this sentence.

flags.text: - **THEN** it SHALL run a machine review and retain its actual receipt/evidence modality, and SHALL never demand a human reviewer or label transcript inference as direct hearing
flags.disposition: Explicit negation/removal of the matched prerequisite; no surviving mandatory human/approval/wire gate in this sentence.

flags.text: - **THEN** it SHALL append the supported LLM resolution to retained earlier findings, and SHALL never require a third person or overwrite prior disagreement
flags.disposition: Explicit negation/removal of the matched prerequisite; no surviving mandatory human/approval/wire gate in this sentence.

flags.text: The system SHALL provide one local workspace without accounts, login, roles, tenant configuration or human reviewer qualification. LLMs SHALL check answers/reviews/disputes.
flags.disposition: Explicit negation/removal of the matched prerequisite; no surviving mandatory human/approval/wire gate in this sentence.

flags.text: The compiler SHALL retain original/surface text, source notices, mutation IDs and actual prompt/provider versions. Linguistic audit SHALL be a machine action with no subsequent human review prerequisite.
flags.disposition: Explicit negation/removal of the matched prerequisite; no surviving mandatory human/approval/wire gate in this sentence.

flags.text: The team SHALL use the actual user-approved product scope and permit labelled deterministic test examples without per-example or per-property approval. It SHALL never treat model output as actual source/provider observations or a human signature.
flags.disposition: Explicit negation/removal of the matched prerequisite; no surviving mandatory human/approval/wire gate in this sentence.

flags.text: A plausible key defect SHALL invoke LLM adjudication with retained evidence. Correct novel correction wording SHALL be evaluated against semantic propositions, without human review.
flags.disposition: Explicit negation/removal of the matched prerequisite; no surviving mandatory human/approval/wire gate in this sentence.

flags.text: Supported intended uses remain local_analysis, internal_training, commercial_evaluation, derivative_exercises, distribution, model_training, external_api_transfer and voice_use. Default local setup uses local_analysis/derivative_exercises; operator selects permitted uses under actual source terms. Retain source notices and any supplied agreements; no legal reviewer UI, per-transfer signed approval, grant graph or permission-epoch machinery is required. API access alone does not grant a license. User approval of specification use does not create missing third-party rights.
flags.disposition: Explicit negation/removal of the matched prerequisite; no surviving mandatory human/approval/wire gate in this sentence.
